# TPC-Havoc Q1_v10

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN l_returnflag = 'A'
    THEN 'A'
    WHEN l_returnflag = 'N'
    THEN 'N'
    WHEN l_returnflag = 'R'
    THEN 'R'
    ELSE l_returnflag
  END AS l_returnflag,
  CASE
    WHEN l_linestatus = 'F'
    THEN 'F'
    WHEN l_linestatus = 'O'
    THEN 'O'
    ELSE l_linestatus
  END AS l_linestatus,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT l_quantity IS NULL THEN l_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS sum_qty,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT l_extendedprice IS NULL THEN l_extendedprice ELSE 0 END) AS sum_base_price,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN NOT l_extendedprice IS NULL AND NOT l_discount IS NULL
      THEN l_extendedprice * (
        1 - l_discount
      )
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS sum_disc_price,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN NOT l_extendedprice IS NULL AND NOT l_discount IS NULL AND NOT l_tax IS NULL
      THEN l_extendedprice * (
        1 - l_discount
      ) * (
        1 + l_tax
      )
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS sum_charge,
  AVG(CASE WHEN NOT l_quantity IS NULL THEN l_quantity END) AS avg_qty,
  AVG(CASE WHEN NOT l_extendedprice IS NULL THEN l_extendedprice END) AS avg_price,
  AVG(CASE WHEN NOT l_discount IS NULL THEN l_discount END) AS avg_disc,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT l_returnflag IS NULL AND NOT l_linestatus IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS count_order
FROM lineitem
WHERE
  l_shipdate <= CASE
    WHEN NOT '1998-12-01' IS NULL
    THEN CAST('1998-12-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '90 DAY'
    ELSE CAST('1998-09-02' AS DATE)
  END
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN l_returnflag = 'A'
    THEN 'A'
    WHEN l_returnflag = 'N'
    THEN 'N'
    WHEN l_returnflag = 'R'
    THEN 'R'
    ELSE l_returnflag
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN l_linestatus = 'F'
    THEN 'F'
    WHEN l_linestatus = 'O'
    THEN 'O'
    ELSE l_linestatus
  END
ORDER BY
  l_returnflag,
  l_linestatus
```
